about: Things to test on this beta. Tick each one off. If something is wrong, tap Report a problem on it.

checks.text: Settings › Read aloud: pick Female. It downloads once on Wi-Fi.
Long-press a message, then Read aloud. It speaks in the new voice.
Switch to Male. It downloads and speaks.
Turn it on in Settings › Look. A card appears at the top of the chat list.
Open it: "What it means", Read aloud and Earlier verses all work. X hides it for today.
With a pattern lock, it asks you to set an unlock password (typed twice, then once from memory).
Both the pattern and the unlock password unlock.
5 wrong tries: a 5 minute wait. The message clears when the wait ends.
A correct unlock right after a wrong one resets the count.
A pattern of under 4 dots says "Connect at least 4 dots" and doesn't count.
Restart the phone during a wait. The wait continues and doesn't start over.
Turn it on: the explanation, then the warnings, then Confirm.
Calls show "Calls are off while Ultra privacy is on."
Messages still send and arrive (slower).
Turn it off and on again 3 times. Messages still work.
After updating, turn full-screen alerts back on once. The next update should keep them on.
Parent: pick a voice for the kid device.
Kids' TV: open a message with OK, then Read aloud with the remote.
Restart the kid device during quiet hours. Messages from non-parents wait.
The unlock password screen works with only the controller (B always leaves).
The button hints at the top only show buttons that work.
Send a short video to a group. It arrives, and the receiver can't see where it was filmed.
It has 4 rows: Camera, Saved media, Encrypted file sharing, Poll.
Tap the shutter for a photo.
Hold for a video (the ring fills, up to 1:00). Let go to stop.
Pick photos, a video and a GIF together (up to 10). They all send.
On the same Wi-Fi: the transfer shows "Nearby".
With a trusted contact away from home: it shows "Trusted direct".
With someone not trusted, or Ultra on: it shows "Tor, slower".
Other person offline: it says "Sends when they're online", then sends when they come back.
Turn Wi-Fi off mid-transfer: it carries on over another path.
The card shows the name, trust badge, type, size and method, with Accept and Decline.
A ZIP shows "Only open this if you were expecting it."
"Always accept" shows only for trusted contacts and family.
Decline: the sender sees "Declined".
Nearby: a long video goes full size.
Away from home: a 1080p video asks "Shrink to 720p to send?"
A video over 5 minutes says "Video too long" and offers "Send as a file". Nothing is ever cut.
Ultra privacy on: a saved video sends over Tor, and calls stay off.
The slider starts at 80%. "Hear a sample" plays at the chosen speed.
Parent: set a speed for the kid device.
Every slider moves smoothly, with no notches (falling leaves, volume, kid mic, PC zoom, PC Look).
On the handheld, holding the d-pad speeds the slider up.
Group voice chat is called "Voice room" everywhere.
Privacy and lock goes Lock, Privacy, Nearby, Ultra privacy, More.
Read aloud has one page, under Look › Accessibility.
Linked devices and Move each open their own page.
Labs is one page.
Person details: "Trusted direct" and "Send me files" (Ask / Always / Off).
PC: one person menu, and Forward shows once.
